mods.name: ChestDiff
mods.description: git diff ahh but minecraft chests. Highlights what changed in a container (added/removed/swapped items) and who or what did it.

releases.notes:
Initial release for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).

**Features**

- Tints changed slots when opening a container: green for additions, red for removals, yellow for swaps
- Ghost icon for emptied slots so you can see what was taken at a glance
- Tooltip on hover shows before/after counts (+3 Cobblestone, - Diamond Sword, ~ Oak Log → Stripped Oak Log)
- Persistent local cache - diffs survive game restarts and work on any server with no server-side mod required
- Double chest support with unified diff across both halves
- Configurable via Mod Menu: symbol vs. word tooltips, session-only vs. persistent cache

**Requirements**

- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu (optional, for in-game config)
